notes.title: 2022/12/06 SteamClosing Notice
notes.notes:
Dear player:

In response to the National Day of Mourning on December 6, 2022, the game will be suspended for one day from 00:00 on December 6.
It is expected to resume after 00:00 on December 7, subject to the actual opening time of the game.
Thank you for your understanding and support!

Official communication QQ group: 729566167
